content: A channel to organize epilogues via threads. the story is over so go ahead and let us know where your character goes from here. almost anyone has a chance to be immortalized into future seasons and it's a good way to collect your thoughts on how your character did and how you want them to be remembered by your fellow players. make a thread and go nuts!

Cairn and Fuddles Epilogue     

After the grand opening of their restaurant Sesame Sweet. Sonny and Fuddles entrust the operations of the restaurant to JJ and Kegbot. Cairn, intent on finding his twin sister, Iona, uses a Minor Wish, bestowed upon him by the Mender, to reclaim his lost compass from Sonora the Water Elemental. 

When the two reunite with Cairns’ sister, Iona, she has surprisingly located the Fountain of Youth in Meso-Arcania. Outsmarting a host of conquistadors along the way, the waters of the mythical fountain cured all ailments including the curse and bestowed upon them a longevity that to this day has yet to run its course.

When they return to Empire City, it is to their surprise that JJ and Kegbot have fallen in love and made a life for themselves. They live happily working at the restaurant and spending their free time together.

Sonny and Fuddles eventually settle in Murray Hill Park and raise their 6 children to know of Gill and walk in the ways of The Mender. In her free time, Fuddles helps take care of the park and the Mender’s cottage. She continues to keep in contact with Roy and Sabrine to see how the spreading of the word of Sandigill is progressing.

Rizzo the oldest moves out west to follow a dream, but dies on the journey from tuberculosis. He never is able to live out his dream of becoming rich
Fozzie works at the restaurant and eventually taking over with his wife Sophine and their 3 children.
Bert and Ernie the twins open a joke shop in the city. It's not hard for them to entertain everyone being bards like their dad. They look just like him. 
Zoe will join The Menders and become a Night Shifter and study as a druid. She helps Roy spread the word of Sandigill.
Abby travels west healing people as she goes. Finding there is much need for her as a Cleric. As she travel meets a bard named Chad. Chad is full of himself but Abby is determined to show him the error of his ways. They fall in love and have 2 children.

Vivica's PoV: 
**1778: **After the war ends, Vivica will help organize the first elections of the Triumvirate, ensuring it is a fair election and everyone gets their vote in. She will continue to work as a Lamplighter, helping Nolan restore it to its full potential. Quackers watches the mothman egg with diligence before Irynx is ready to take it out west. She is sad to see it go, but has too many chocolate eggs of her own to deal with so the sadness doesn’t last long. 
    Vivica, Finn, and Quackers, will move from the Golden Voice to a large penthouse, part of a building that is owned by the Midsak family. They will also make sure Julie and Eliza, Nolan and Bowen, and Marcos have apartments in the same building, so as to keep their family close by. For his next birthday Bowen will receive a pet ferret from Vivica, something he was very happy to receive, naming it Pabu. 

  **  1789:**Vivica turns her attention back to France. The United States of Arcania as a nation is still healing from war, but France is calling for us to return the favor and aid them in their Revolution. Vivica becomes a huge advocate for the states to aid France in their time of need, even to the point of having Finn liquidate some assets so she can send supplies. She will go back and forth between Arcania and France running supply lines to the revolutionaires in her home country, except for about the 8 months she spends in the thick of the fight. 

    **1797:**  Quackers just becomes an overpampered duck and eventually finds a nice boy duck where they have weird magic chocolate duck babies. 

    **1803:**Jefferson becomes part of the Triumvirate. He sends Vivica and Finn as Representatives of the US of Arcania to work out a deal for the Louisiana Purchase with Napoleon. Vivica with her close relations in France and Finn with his past experience in office.

**1811:** Vivica, Finn and Friends move out west to California, where Finn creates the beginnings of Hollywood. Vivica opens a luxury chocolate shop where she sells Quackers chocolate eggs. She will change professions to be a Lawyer and become dedicated to ensuring the practice of Restorative justice out in the west.

    **1838 and on:**  Vivica questions Finn on the fact that he isn’t dead yet because as a changeling, he should have died of old age by now. Finn finally lets go of the secret that he used wish to give him the lifespan of an elf. They continue their work, and live a life full of love, excitement and weird little chocolate duckies that they have continued to raise in their free time. They keep their friends Eliza and Nolan close, and welcome anyone from their days on the Golden Voice into their home, if they so choose to visit.

Vivica's Epilogue is posted in the midask thread ✌️

**1778-1788**
After helping save the city with the others, Finn makes sure that everyone is recognized as the heroes they are and will throw a massive parade throughout the city. Within the next few days of crafting he enchants a magic ring of 3 wishes. He wishes for the following: ***To live the lifespan of elves.  Wish two is that his retainers live as long as he does.*** He then keeps the ring as his own wedding ring and never resorts to using it again.He has everything he needs: a life with Vivica. He doesn’t tell anyone of his wishes and lets it be a secret for as long as he can before the wife eventually catches on in 60 years.

When all is said and done and the new nation is ready to elect their leaders, Finn joins them and serves in the first Triumvirate for 2 terms alongside George Washington and another founder of the nation. He uses his power there to help clarify the constitution and guide laws in its intentions.

During his terms he will organize the New York Convention defining war crimes and limits to collateral damage, not wanting to let there be any more innocents in the line of fire. He will attempt to bring this to the attention of powers world wide to come to an agreement that limits the cost of blood in war. 

**1789-1811**
After working as a public servant Finn will go into illusion mastery and develop the first Movers and the Cinema Scene while helping with policy in the cabinets of the Triumvirs to follow. He works defining and defending laws as an attorney. After helping negotiate on Thomas Jefferson’s behalf with Vivica as they serve in his cabinet for the Louisiana Purchase **(1803)**, Finn heads West with friends to settle in California **(1811)**. While there, he begins Hollywood and the boom of entertainment.

**1880-1927**
He has a workforce consisting of dozens of retainers that build him penthouses and a castle outside the city. He stayed a news Tycoon with his periodic radio broadcasts but began to research a way to bring his Cinema Movers to small illusions inside everyone’s houses. Telemetric Illusory Movers or TIMs for short. 

**1927- Onwards**
He finds he’s at his height of enjoyment when he sees joy, wonder, and inspiration in other’s eyes. His innovations stay in humanitarian efforts, news broadcasts, and anything and everything in entertainment.

**Epilogues of Finn's Retainers**
**1778- Onward**
His retainers live similarly long and fruitful lives much to their surprise after about 20 years of slow aging finally realizing something was up and confronting Finn about it naturally. **(1800)**

Marcos began taking over operations of Midask industries. He grows out of his edgy teenage phase and helps greatly expand into all new markets. Humanitarianism, Technology Advancement, Free Press, and Entertainment as its four massive pillars. He settles down as head of the company with Finn deciding to really focus on his passion in entertainment, and eventually meets the daughter of the premier inventor of the toughest wagons out there. Asami Ford. They date for a few years before getting married and running their businesses together. Their children are the ones that eventually inherit the company of the Midask family as Finn and Vivica regard them as their own. Finn raised Bowen and Marcos and always wanted to see them succeed and live their lives. 

Bowen, between helping with lamplighting and rising in ranks left with his friends to star in many of the movers as Nuktuk and Pabu, Heroes of the Revolution. He loved stardom and feeling like he brought hope to others just like Finn does. 

Him and Nolan form a strong relationship and eventually get married. They go on several more adventures and always share their mutual love for Mac and Cheese. 
After Nolan dies in **1846 ** Bowen will have a friend in the form of Opal, the living shadow formed from Nolan’s cloak. She is named after Nolan’s mom, and funnily enough it just works out.

After the war ended Julie was Finn's personal assistant while he served in the Triumvirate for 10 years. She freshened up her skills in fighting and organized the first secret service. When Finn was out of office she joined in the adventure with her wife Eliza and the Midask family gang going out into the world. She works for Finn, her childhood best friend but finds greater and new purpose with Eliza. 


Finn's retainers inherit and share in everything much before Finn is ready to pass on. The Midask family legacy continues through them and their descendants.

Elizas Epilogue
Eliza's Epilogue

Dear Diary, 
August 25th 1778,

We killed off the king and his unwanted friends. Lots have already changed, many places were ransacked by the Redcoats and it took a fighting stance to finish them off before the day was truly over. Though peace is already noticeable as the town has started rebuilding and the pubs are restocked (interesting how that was the priority…). There is  also a lot more cheer in people’s eyes, and from what I can tell a lot more freedom. We ended today with no weight for tomorrow, and Finn threw another pool party! I really liked my drink with the little umbrella in it….

August 20th 1779,

It has been a year since our battle and our independence. Empire City has grown slightly and most of it is back to normal. Though the lamplighter office still needed help, and with how much crime there still seems to be, I think I will go back to helping Nolan and the other lamplighters bring back balance and order. With the new Constitution in place, we have a good system to help enforce it! 

Our new place that Vivica and Finn let us stay has been filling in nicely, Julie has been going crazy with crafting things and decorating but she seems to also take a liking to cooking, which I am thankful for… *Food stain here*

Oh P.S.! Julie has also been working with Finn on getting him through this government thing we seemed to have put together while we fought this war. I don’t get to see her very often as of late because of this whole ‘office' thing but when we do, she and I go to the range. Luckily I forced her into doing another one so soon after our last tomorrow!

-
December 31st 1799,

It’s the final night of the 1700s and I have to say there is a lot of a future ahead of us! Nolan has been director of the lamplighters for sometime now and I have been working under/partnered with them for many dangerous cases. But we have also been slowly expanding! What started as a few interns to help clean up the office and help them get off the streets have been turning into full fledged lamplighters. Vivica has been showing them the ropes and as of today we all agreed to promote a couple more! This is wonderful news, I know with the amount of work Nolan has put into this, we are finally starting to lighten work on them. 

Although, I did start thinking about something tonight. My lovely wife Julie is mortal, and I started to think about how much longer I have with them… I looked into a couple of files from the archives we have in the office, and I found some things that violet and a couple of other people we fought explain that there might be a way to create this… Wish. I won’t be telling her my plans until I look into it further, but I hope to let her live as long as I do. 

On other news though from today, Julie and I talked about an interesting idea over our normal shooting range date. She has been practicing her fighting and strength for quite some time, and she has learned how to be rather sneaky around the house. I learned it was because she was wanting to see if she could start a secret service department within the lamplighters. I think the idea is amazing and brought it up to Nolan and Vivica, which they both also agreed. So, starting today! Julie is now the head of the Secret Service department that handles top cases that we were working on and protects our country from any problems. Not that a lot of people outside the top of the lamplighters know… I did notice her age really doesn’t seem to bother her, she acts as young as we first met! And punch the same for that matter…
Nolan’s Epilogue
Nolan Reeve’s Epilogue

-
July 4th 1811,

The day has finally come, the lamplighters as a whole have evolved into something great! We now have a minimum of 3 people working in each department and a couple of the original rookies stepping up into our roles. Nolan, Vivica, Julie and I have decided to retire from this job and make a change of scenery. We decided to move west along with other friends from our good war days. Julie and I also decided to do more adventuring to help keep our skills active, but also let us discover new places! She’s still wanting to be there for Finn, but for the first time, she hasn’t worried about him as much and worried more about me… I think she’s either tired of Finn, or she is starting to be a little more independent. Seems to be a running theme for our country. Now if only Finn would take the dumb flag colors off his damn toilet cover! But he does feed me plenty of alcohol, so I can’t complain…

I also checked on Kegbot, and it looks like he found a cute robot named JJ. WAIT, that’s Sonny’s bot! I should have seen this sooner… He seems very happy with where he is at, and how his life is going. I gave him the news and was a little sad, but I gave him the truly free protocol and that seemed to change his mind. He also always has a tracker on me, so he knows where he has a home if he needs it.

Oh, and to update on my search for a way to extend Julie’s life. I get the feeling I don’t need to anymore. It’s been nearly 30 years from when we met and she hardly looks any different nor acts like she’s older. I suspect Finn has something to do with it… He always knows the thing everyone needs! Though now that I think about it, he also seems no different…

-
March 2nd 1838,

Vivica confronted Finn about his age, and my suspicions were right! He used a wish to make him and his retainers live as long as us elves! Julie is still processing this, but I managed to get her some tea and she fell right asleep easily this evening. She did have the cutest smile when she saw me. Must have been her realizing she gets to spend many more years dealing with my Summer phases. 

We have been happily living in California with our closest friends nearby. We have been asked to be actors by Finn, but I think my seasons make it hard to play a particular role. Julie has been lovin it, but she still sometimes finds herself helping Finn more than she is acting.  She will never change. 

It has been quite a lot to get to this point, but I have say so myself, this has been an amazing adventure! Though I do wonder if Finn still has one of those bombs we had many years ago?

Until tomorrow, 
Eliza
